changes: Fixed the Nudge button — most likely cause was its server function never actually being deployed, not a client-side bug. Rewritten from scratch on the same proven pattern the Casino Pot notifications already use.

Profile cards now show Casino win/loss record, Tipping season points + record, and a Fines section (this person's own estimated contribution to the pot fines) — nothing removed, everything from before is still there.
Gave the whole profile card a premium visual pass: richer stat cards, a gold accent on the name and section markers, upgraded Challenge/Nudge buttons, a richer prestige bar.
Added a Casino Pot fine system, on top of the existing 15% burn: a losing Group Multi leg fines the pot 250,000 XP, and every individual wrong AFL tip fines the pot 150,000 XP.
